description: Extends the L.Marker class from Leaflet to add custom methods for hiding and showing markers with opacity adjustments without overwriting the original opacity option.

classes.name: L.Marker
classes.description: The Marker class from the Leaflet library, extended with additional methods for cluster hiding and showing.

methods.name: clusterHide
methods.description: Sets marker opacity to 0, effectively hiding it, while preserving the original opacity in options.

methods.name: clusterShow
methods.description: Restores marker opacity to the original value stored in options, effectively showing it.
